model: Leggero Limited Edition Team Rim Brake Frameset
description: These frameset have custom race geometry selected by our pro team riders. The limited edition geometry is ideally suited to shorter circuit races. Geometry is more aggressive that our standard Leggero and is ideal for those looking for a racing and aerodynamic position.Made from super-light, super-stiff, high modulus carbon fibre, the Leggero is a balance of light and fast. Featuring wind-slicing, droplet-shaped tubes and our finest nano carbon technology, the Leggero provides a responsive ride that jumps the second you drive power through the pedals. Developed with riders from our former pro team, JLT Condor (also known as Rapha Condor team). Countless hours of feedback and testing have continually helped the Leggero evolve and it riders at the front of the peloton. The updated design is speedier than its predecessor with improved aerodynamic efficiency. The frameset features oversized square stays, for increased power transfer and stiffness, the Leggero will be at home on a group ride, tackling climbs or sprinting for the finish line under a rider as powerful as Ed Clancy. Our carbon is proven through everything from one-day classic race to long, gruelling stage races.
